artifacts.summary: Answers Q1-Q5 on porting BimodalLogic task 696's landed trans/Liftable stability-modal substrate redesign to ModelChecker's bimodal theory: names the exact determinism assumption (lasso orbits = histories) that the thread/trans/Liftable account replaces, maps each lesson to a certificate.py/witness_registry.py/witness_constraints.py file target, confirms the wire-level export contract is additive with no change needed now, and finds BimodalLogic task 696 completed mid-research (famA/famB gate families landed), making ModelChecker task 200's re-scoped text and task 219's examples.py THEORY-LIMITS group both one increment stale -- includes concrete re-scoping/amendment text for both plus a phased now-vs-later proposal.

memory_candidates.content: In the BimodalLogic/ModelChecker witness-family certificate design, the load-bearing assumption behind 'histories = lasso orbits' (hence Box-faithfulness = finite conjunction over lasso positions) is determinism: every shift-relation fibre is a singleton. This is documented explicitly in ModelChecker bimodal's docs/ADEQUACY.md ('Why the design is deterministic') and mirrors BimodalLogic's own total_eq_orbit/total_eq_thread distinction. Any future state-sharing extension on either side must separate state identity (an equivalence, 'share') from one-step succession (a possibly-free relation, 'trans') from the start -- conflating them forces local coherence clauses to collapse to class invariants (the defect BimodalLogic task 696 spent two research rounds diagnosing and repairing).

When a research task cites another repository's task status/timestamp as grounding for a re-scoped description, that status can go stale within hours if the cited task is actively in flight. Before trusting a cross-repository re-scoped task description, re-run a live grep for the concrete artifact the cited task was supposed to produce (e.g. new field/theorem names) rather than trusting the status field or a cached report alone -- confirmed a genuine case where a ModelChecker task's re-scoped text (citing BimodalLogic task 696 as 'implementing') went stale ~5 hours later when 696 completed.
